integrity: One self-contained theorem with exact formula, asymptotic proof, and a reproducible standalone exact checker; no independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Complete rooted n-ary depth-two trees with independent fair Boolean valuations only; alternate variable-degree ensembles and the meaning of Conjecture 38 outside the fixed-branching setting are not addressed. Historical novelty is not independently certified.
title: Poisson amplification and a counterexample to the recursive-limit conjecture for counting modal logic
